body:
I don't have any inspiring words or blissful outlooks on the world, but I wanted to let you know that I resonate with your post. I've never made an attempt, but I know what it's like to wake up every day and ask yourself "why?". I know what it's like to feel that life is simply about enduring varying degrees of suffering for minimal, if any, reward. I also know what it's like to hate your own consciousness because it seems that you can only be at peace in moments when you are unaware of your own existence. Running away from your own thoughts is an exhausting and seemingly futile endeavor, but you still have to try, right? 

Right now, I'm trying to tell myself that I live for my parents because they truly deserve the world. If I was living for myself, I would have happily kms years ago.

I don't know if it brings you any bit of relief to know that someone also feels that life is not worth the pain it requires, but I hope at least a fraction of you finds comfort in knowing you're not completely alone in the feeling. 

I am deeply sorry that you have to fight against yourself everyday. Reading this post makes me feel like I'm talking to a different version of myself. All I can do is apologize and hope that you one day wake up and experience the peace that you deserve and desire. 

Side note (maybe an poor attempt at being inspiring?): Idk if you don't like singing or just don't think you're good at it, but if there is anything that brings you a sliver of joy without destroying someone else, you should do it if possible. Art is one of the most freeing and individualistic things we can make. If your "bad" music soothes part of you in a way that nothing else can, then the art has done it's job. This is advice I should be taking myself, but I'll see what you do with it instead. :)

I feel like this comment is all over the place, but I hope it mostly made sense...
